title: 応用化学専門実験・演習A2
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises A2
keywords: Organic synthesis 2.Spectrometric identification 3.Structure determination of organic compounds
educationalGoal: You will learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation in the field of organic chemistry. You will also acquire the ability to evaluate the results from qualitative and quantitative experiments, and perform logical thinking. Through experiments and exercises, you will learn experimental theories and methods.
advice: Conduct experiments and exercises in the field of organic chemistry. If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before the next class through research, questions, or other methods. - Experimental guidance - Safety training - Advanced skills for organic synthesis - Extraction of caffeine - Synthesis of acetylsalicylic acid - Synthesis of azo dyes - Preparation and characterization of conducting polymers (or polymethylmethacrylate)
books: Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Senmon Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing, in Japanese) Reserved books: Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing, in Japanese), Zoku Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing, in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental knowledge about analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry. If progress of the experiment is delayed, time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the class on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Handle instruments and equipment safely and explain the experimental procedures.
Read the instructions using technical terms and conduct the experiments yourself.
Understand the theoretical basis of the experiments and logically examine experimental results.
Prepare a report from the experiments.
Understand basic experimental procedures and perform specific experiments.

achievementLevels.ideal: By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following: - Use experimental instruments safely and accurately. - Understand and use the analytical apparatus. - Devise a personal experimental plan according to the experimental instructions and conduct the experiments. - Prepare a report logically and hand in by the deadline.
achievementLevels.standard: By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following: - Use experimental instruments safely. - Use the analytical apparatus. - Conduct the experiments according to the experimental instructions. - Prepare a report and hand in by the deadline.

lessons.content: Safety training and instruction for organic chemistry experiments -Extraction of caffeine
lessons.assignments: Readings: Section Organic Chemistry, Chapter 0 "Safety Rules" Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare an experimental workflow for extraction from natural sources. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
